verdict.rationale: Bevy is explicitly a code-first Rust ECS engine—components are Rust structs and systems are Rust functions (bevy-docs-14, bevy-docs-42, bevy-docs-20)—with no visual scripting or node-based editor mentioned anywhere; community commenters even note the lack of an editor comparable to Godot's (bevy-comm-6, bevy-comm-7).
